generator.params.note: Flora of Pakistan, Caryota urens (read 2026-10-18): a solitary, ringed trunk to 12 m; leaves to 3.5 m or more and 3 m wide, borne along the trunk, the primary divisions 1.2 to 1.5 m long, obliquely cut off at their ends. Flora of North America (vol. 22) has the leaves 5 to 7 m and the stem over 15 cm through; Wikipedia (Caryota urens, read 2026-10-18) a trunk 30 cm wide, a petiole about 60 cm and leaflets about 30 cm. Drawn as a trunk 0.15 m in radius; fronds 5.6 m long, the petiole 0.12 of them; the longest pinna 0.26 of the frond (1.45 m) and its longest leaflet 0.3 of the pinna (0.44 m), so most leaflets are 20 to 30 cm; six fronds a year living three years, each frond 5 cm up the trunk from the last and the trunk rising 0.25 m a year besides, so the leaves stand spread along the top two metres of the trunk (estimated, set by eye from photographs).

traits.clonal.note: Flora of North America (vol. 22), Caryota key: stems solitary, more than 15 cm through, in C. urens; clustered in C. mitis.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of Pakistan, Caryota urens (read 2026-10-18): the trunk to 12 m.

traits.height_max_m.note: Wikipedia, Caryota urens (read 2026-10-18): to 18 m tall.

traits.stem_diameter_max_m.note: Wikipedia, Caryota urens (read 2026-10-18): the trunk about 30 cm wide; Flora of North America (vol. 22): more than 15 cm.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of Pakistan, Caryota urens (read 2026-10-18): leaves to 3.5 m long or more; Flora of North America (vol. 22) gives 5 to 7 m. Read as 3.5 to 6 m of blade.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Wikipedia, Caryota urens (read 2026-10-18): a petiole about 60 cm.

traits.pinnae.note: No flora read counts the primary pinnae; secondary compilations (Llifle, read 2026-10-18) give five to seven pairs up to 1.5 m long, which fits Flora of Pakistan's 1.2 to 1.5 m divisions on a leaf 3 m wide. Drawn as six pairs, to be checked against a flora or specimens.

traits.leaflets.note: No flora read counts the leaflets on a pinna: thirteen a side and one at the tip, set by eye so leaflets about 30 cm long (Wikipedia) fill a pinna about 1.4 m long.

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Wikipedia, Caryota urens (read 2026-10-18): the leaflets obdeltoid, about 30 cm long, jagged at their ends.

allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species: about 7 m at 10 years and 14 m at 20 to the top of the crown, its trunk then near Flora of Pakistan's 12 m. Wide tolerances.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact: twenty years, before the stem flowers and dies, which is not drawn.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy: a solitary fishtail palm with twice-pinnate fronds of wedge-shaped, jagged leaflets. It is hapaxanthic, flowering from the top down and then dying, which is not drawn.
